description:
List every gnomAD variant in a gene, transcript, or region with allele frequencies, filtering allele frequencies, zygosity counts, predicted consequences with LOFTEE's loss-of-function call, and QC status, optionally filtered by consequence class, LOFTEE confidence, maximum allele frequency, and maximum filtering allele frequency (faf95_max) — the value to test against a disease threshold such as ACMG/AMP BA1 or BS1, which raw AF is not. Pass annotations: true to add each row's HGVS c. and p. notation, LOFTEE filter and flags, and rsIDs, and populations: true to add its allele count, number, and frequency in each genetic-ancestry group. qc_status follows gnomAD's browser: pass when at least one callset carrying the variant passed QC, filtered when none did (often AC0, no high-quality carrier, at AF 0). The browser hides filtered variants by default and qc_filtered counts them: read them as low-confidence, not observed variants, or pass pass_only to drop them. Each call returns one page: up to limit matching variants from offset, in gnomAD's genomic order, with total counting every match; pass next_offset as offset until it is null. gnomAD lists a target only whole, so each page re-fetches the whole target — page a large gene with filters and a large limit. At offset 0, a result too large to inline is also staged as a DataCanvas table, gene_variants, holding every matching variant (canvas_id, table_name) — call gnomad_dataframe_describe for its columns, then gnomad_dataframe_query to rank, count, or group across every row rather than one page. A page past offset 0 never stages. Supply exactly one of gene, transcript_id, or region. Echoes the resolved target, the row filters, and the effective dataset and build.
Data source: gnomAD (Broad Institute) — https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/

annotations.description: Add hgvsc, hgvsp, lof_filter, lof_flags, and rsids (pipe-joined), describing each row's transcript_id, after every default column, on the rows and in the staged gene_variants table. A column toggle, not a filter: it keeps every row and filters does not echo it. It widens each row, and each page's re-fetch of the target from gnomAD, by about a quarter.

canvas_id.description: canvas_id from a prior call. A call at offset 0 then writes its result to gene_variants on that canvas, replacing the previous table and its columns even when the result fits inline; a result with no variants removes it, and a page past offset 0 leaves it as it was. Omit to stage on a fresh canvas only when the result is too large to inline.

consequence_class.description: Keep only variants in this gnomAD consequence category, read from each row's consequence: lof (pLoF) is transcript_ablation, splice_acceptor_variant, splice_donor_variant, stop_gained, frameshift_variant; missense (missense / inframe indel) is missense_variant, stop_lost, start_lost, inframe_insertion, inframe_deletion; synonymous is synonymous_variant; other is every other term and a null consequence.

dataset.description: gnomAD dataset, default gnomad_r4: gnomad_r4 and its subset gnomad_r4_non_ukb (GRCh38); gnomad_r3 and its subsets gnomad_r3_controls_and_biobanks, gnomad_r3_non_cancer, gnomad_r3_non_neuro, gnomad_r3_non_topmed, gnomad_r3_non_v2 (GRCh38); gnomad_r2_1 and its subsets gnomad_r2_1_controls, gnomad_r2_1_non_cancer, gnomad_r2_1_non_neuro, gnomad_r2_1_non_topmed (GRCh37); exac (GRCh37). A subset keeps part of its parent release's samples (non_cancer drops cancer-study samples, non_ukb UK Biobank's) and can leave a callset unchanged: gnomad_r4_non_ukb genome counts equal gnomad_r4's, and gnomad_r2_1_non_cancer genome counts equal gnomad_r2_1's.

anyOf.description: Gene — HGNC symbol (e.g. PCSK9) or Ensembl gene ID (e.g. ENSG00000169174). Obtain a stable ID from ensembl_lookup_gene.
Blank — the gene is treated as omitted.

gene.description: Gene, as an HGNC symbol or Ensembl gene ID; mitochondrial genes (e.g. MT-TL1) are not served.

limit.description: Matching variants on this page. Default 25; a value above 3,000 is clamped to 3,000, with a notice.

lof_confidence.description: Keep only variants whose lof equals this; a row with lof null or OS matches neither.

max_af.description: Keep only variants with allele frequency ≤ this value (0–1). Variants with null AF are always kept.

max_faf.description: Keep only variants whose faf95_max is ≤ this value (0–1). Variants with a null faf95_max are always kept, and a notice counts them.

offset.description: Zero-based position, among the variants the filters keep, of the first one on this page; pass next_offset to continue.

pass_only.description: Keep only qc_status pass variants, with the counts gnomAD's browser table shows by default: on every dataset but gnomad_r4 (gnomad_r4_non_ukb included), a row reads ac, an, af, homozygote_count, hemizygote_count, faf95_max, and the populations columns from its passing callsets only, and max_af and max_faf filter on those values; gnomad_r4 rows keep their joint counts. Omitted, QC-failed variants stay listed, so a single-position region never reads as absent because of QC.

populations.description: Add ac_<group>, an_<group>, and af_<group> for each genetic-ancestry group of the dataset after every other column, on the rows and in the staged gene_variants table — afr ami amr asj eas fin mid nfe remaining sas on gnomad_r4 and gnomad_r4_non_ukb; afr ami amr asj eas fin mid nfe oth sas on gnomad_r3 and its subsets; afr amr asj eas fin nfe oth sas on gnomad_r2_1 and its subsets; afr amr eas fin nfe oth sas on exac. They read the records ac does — gnomAD's joint groups on gnomad_r4, elsewhere each group summed across those callsets — so a row's non-null ac_<group> sum to its ac and an_<group> to its an. A group none of those records lists is null; af_<group> is null when an_<group> is 0. A column toggle like annotations; it about doubles each row and each page's re-fetch of the target from gnomAD.

reference_genome.description: Reference build, derived from dataset when omitted; a build other than the dataset's is rejected. Keep aligned with Ensembl coordinates.

region.description: Genomic region chrom-start-stop (1-based inclusive, e.g. 1-55039447-55064852) on chromosome 1–22, X, or Y with an optional chr prefix, spanning (stop − start) under 2,500,000 bp and holding at most ~30,000 variants.

name: gnomad_list_gene_variants

canvas_id.description: Canvas holding table_name, or the canvas_id supplied; empty when this call used no canvas (the result fit inline with no canvas_id, or the page started past offset 0).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_target`: Not exactly one of gene, transcript_id, or region was supplied. `incoherent_build`: reference_genome was supplied but does not match the dataset. `invalid_region`: The region names a chromosome outside 1–22, X, Y, or breaks the coordinate bounds. `region_too_large`: The region spans 2,500,000 bp or more, or holds more variants (~30,000) than gnomAD lists at once. `mitochondrial_unsupported`: The gene, transcript, or region is on the mitochondrial chromosome (M or MT). `gene_not_found`: gnomAD holds no gene matching the symbol or Ensembl ID in this build. `transcript_not_found`: gnomAD holds no transcript matching transcript_id in this build. `graphql_error`: gnomAD rejected the variant-list query with a GraphQL error. `upstream_unavailable`: gnomAD stayed unavailable or throttled through every retry. `upstream_timeout`: gnomAD attempts timed out or the shared 45 s call budget expired. `upstream_access`: gnomAD refused the request (access denied). `invalid_upstream_response`: gnomAD kept answering with a response that failed validation. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filters.description: The row filters this call applied, each null when omitted.

pass_only.description: true when pass_only was set; null when false.

next_offset.description: offset for the next page; null when this page reaches the last matching variant.

notice.description: Guidance on a clamped limit, no matching variants, QC-failed matches (the qc_filtered count, and what pass_only dropped), max_faf (the kept variants it could not test for a null faf95_max, or a dataset without FAF on its rows), the next offset when no staged table holds the rest, an offset past the end, and the staged table.

preview.description: The matching variants on this page.

ac.description: Allele count: gnomAD's joint exome + genome count on gnomad_r4; on every other dataset, gnomad_r4_non_ukb and the other subsets included (no joint data), the sum across the callsets carrying the variant, a QC-failed one included unless pass_only is set.

ac_afr.description: Allele count in the afr group.

ac_ami.description: Allele count in the ami group.

ac_amr.description: Allele count in the amr group.

ac_asj.description: Allele count in the asj group.

ac_eas.description: Allele count in the eas group.

ac_fin.description: Allele count in the fin group.

ac_mid.description: Allele count in the mid group.

ac_nfe.description: Allele count in the nfe group.

ac_oth.description: Allele count in the oth group.

ac_remaining.description: Allele count in the remaining group.

ac_sas.description: Allele count in the sas group.

af.description: Allele frequency, ac/an — the value max_af filters on; null when an is 0.

af_afr.description: Allele frequency in the afr group.

af_ami.description: Allele frequency in the ami group.

af_amr.description: Allele frequency in the amr group.

af_asj.description: Allele frequency in the asj group.

af_eas.description: Allele frequency in the eas group.

af_fin.description: Allele frequency in the fin group.

af_mid.description: Allele frequency in the mid group.

af_nfe.description: Allele frequency in the nfe group.

af_oth.description: Allele frequency in the oth group.

af_remaining.description: Allele frequency in the remaining group.

af_sas.description: Allele frequency in the sas group.

an.description: Allele number, from the same records as ac: on gnomad_r4 (not gnomad_r4_non_ukb), gnomAD's joint AN over every callable sample in both callsets, including a callset that does not carry the variant or failed QC.

an_afr.description: Allele number in the afr group.

an_ami.description: Allele number in the ami group.

an_amr.description: Allele number in the amr group.

an_asj.description: Allele number in the asj group.

an_eas.description: Allele number in the eas group.

an_fin.description: Allele number in the fin group.

an_mid.description: Allele number in the mid group.

an_nfe.description: Allele number in the nfe group.

an_oth.description: Allele number in the oth group.

an_remaining.description: Allele number in the remaining group.

an_sas.description: Allele number in the sas group.

consequence.description: VEP consequence term, as gnomAD's tables show it: the most severe in the gene on a gene target, the named transcript's term on a transcript target, the most severe across transcripts on a region target; null when none.

consequence_class.description: gnomAD's category of the consequence term; the consequence_class filter lists the terms each holds.

consequence_transcript.description: On a gene target, where transcript_id sits as gnomAD's gene table marks it (†): mane_select, the gene's MANE Select transcript; canonical, the canonical transcript of a gene without a MANE Select (as on every GRCh37 dataset); other, another transcript — a minor isoform, so the consequence and lof may be milder or absent on the primary one, whose term gnomad_get_variant's primary_transcript gives. Null on transcript and region targets, and for a gene with neither a MANE Select nor a canonical transcript.

exome_filters.description: QC filters on the exome call, pipe-joined (e.g. AC0|AS_VQSR; RF on gnomad_r2_1); empty when it passed, null when the exome callset does not carry the variant or gnomAD gave no list.

faf95_max.description: gnomAD's filtering allele frequency (GroupMax FAF95): the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval of a genetic-ancestry group's AF, from the group with the highest bound, over non-bottlenecked groups. From the same records as ac: gnomAD's joint value on gnomad_r4 (gnomad_get_variant's faf95 there); elsewhere the highest a summed callset reports, gnomad_r4_non_ukb's and each gnomad_r2_1 subset's own. Null when gnomAD reports none, as for AC 0 and singleton variants, and on every row of gnomad_r3, its subsets, and exac, whose list rows carry no FAF.

faf95_max_group.description: Genetic-ancestry group faf95_max comes from (e.g. nfe); null when faf95_max is null or gnomAD names none.

gene_id.description: Ensembl ID of transcript_id's gene: the target's on a gene or transcript target. On a region, a variant in overlapping genes is one row, under the gene of its most severe consequence; null there when transcript_id is.

gene_symbol.description: HGNC symbol of gene_id; null when gene_id is or gnomAD gives none.

genome_filters.description: QC filters on the genome call, pipe-joined (e.g. AC0|AS_VQSR; RF on gnomad_r2_1); empty when it passed, null when the genome callset does not carry the variant or gnomAD gave no list.

hemizygote_count.description: Hemizygote count (0 off X/Y), from the same records as ac; null when none of them reports one.

hgvsc.description: HGVS coding or transcript notation on transcript_id (e.g. c.137G>T, c.*9G>T); null when gnomAD gives none. Present only when annotations is true.

hgvsp.description: HGVS protein notation on transcript_id (e.g. p.Arg46Leu); null when gnomAD gives none, as for a UTR or intronic change. Present only when annotations is true.

homozygote_count.description: Homozygote count, from the same records as ac.

lof.description: LOFTEE's loss-of-function call on transcript_id — HC high-confidence, LC low-confidence, or OS other splice; null when LOFTEE made none. Distinct from consequence_class lof, which gnomAD reads from the consequence term, so a pLoF term LOFTEE did not call is still lof there.

lof_filter.description: The LOFTEE filter that made the call on transcript_id low-confidence (e.g. END_TRUNC); null when none. Present only when annotations is true.

lof_flags.description: LOFTEE's flags on the call on transcript_id, as gnomAD writes them (e.g. PHYLOCSF_WEAK, NAGNAG_SITE) — they can qualify an HC call too; null when none. Present only when annotations is true.

qc_status.description: gnomAD's QC verdict for the variant.

rsids.description: dbSNP rsIDs, pipe-joined; empty when gnomAD lists none. gnomad_search_clinvar's table joins its rsids with semicolons. Present only when annotations is true.

transcript_id.description: Ensembl transcript ID (unversioned) the consequence is on; null when gnomAD names none, as for an intergenic variant.

qc_filtered.description: Matching variants with qc_status filtered, counted over every match — not just this page — before pass_only drops them.

spilled.description: True when the matching variants were too large to inline, so table_name holds every one of them.

table_name.description: Canvas table this call staged (gene_variants), holding every matching variant; empty when this call staged no table.

target.description: The resolved target (gene symbol or Ensembl gene ID, transcript ID, or region), as normalized for the lookup.

total.description: Matching variants across every page, counted after pass_only drops QC-failed rows when it is set.

truncated.description: True when matching variants remain past this page; continue with next_offset.

title: gnomad-genetics-mcp-server: list gene variants
